subject.title: fix(config): warn when JSON5 comments are lost on config write

question: Should JSON5 comment-loss remain an existing logger/CLI diagnostic, or become optional fields on the exported `ConfigWriteResult` and `ConfigReplaceResult` contracts?
rationale: The warning itself fixes an established bug, but no current production consumer is shown for the new structured fields, and exported config contracts are compatibility-sensitive under repository policy.

options.title: Keep diagnostics local
options.body: Retain the pre-write warning while removing the optional exported fields, unused detector export, and dead-code baseline entry.

options.title: Adopt structured diagnostics
options.body: Keep the optional fields only with config-owner approval, a named consumer or documented contract purpose, and focused compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics local
recommendation.body: Retain the pre-write warning while removing the optional exported fields, unused detector export, and dead-code baseline entry.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans config warning behavior, write safety, config health, and dead-code cleanup on the exact affected surfaces.
